# OnCore Integration Documentation

## Overview
This REDCap External Module (EM) provides automated transfer of participant data between REDCap and OnCore (by Advarra). It periodically scans IRB numbers entered in the REDCap Project Setup page and compares them with OnCore protocols. Matching projects can then link, allowing subject data syncing where OnCore is considered the 'Source of Truth.'

## Prerequisites
1. OnCore API version 2021R3 or newer.
2. REDCap Entity API External Module (from the University of Florida) must be enabled before this EM.
3. One OnCore instance can be configured (multiple instances are not currently supported).
4. The OnCore protocol must already exist in OnCore before linking to a REDCap project.
5. To push data from REDCap to OnCore, the OnCore study must be in an allowed status.

## Systemwide Setup
A REDCap administrator needs to configure system-level settings in the external module:
1. Base OnCore URL (e.g. https://oncore.[INSTITUTION-NAME].edu)
2. OnCore API Auth URN (e.g. forte-platform-web/api/oauth/token)
3. OnCore API URN (e.g. oncore-api/rest/)
4. Global OnCore API user client_id and client_secret (consult OnCore documentation for generation)
5. A JSON definition describing properties of OnCore fields. See the README for an example.
6. Define OnCore Protocol staff roles allowed to push data.
7. Define OnCore Protocol statuses that accept new subjects via API.
8. Define OnCore Protocol study sites.

## Linking a REDCap Project to OnCore
1. Create or select an existing REDCap project.
